description: A large tawny, spotted sabre-toothed cat with a lion-like head, rounded ears and a long tail stalks low through tall dry grass toward the viewer under a stormy sky. Long canines are bared; no chin flanges are visible. Painterly style, no text, no frame, nothing gory.
reason: Shows a generic sabre-toothed cat (Smilodon-like, with a cat's face and spotted coat), but the card is Thylacosmilus, a South American pouched marsupial that was not a cat. Redraw it as a low marsupial predator with bony chin flanges sheathing the sabre canines.
